assumptions_challenged: Assumption that no SGL‑001 MCB/WCB establishment and characterization records exist
Assumption that no validated orthogonal intact‑EV assay reports (LLOQ, specificity vs non‑vesicular particles, precision) exist for SGL‑001
Assumption that no GMP‑like batch production and release/stability data exist for SGL‑001
Assumption that no stability‑indicating, mechanism‑linked potency assay correlated to an in vivo PD readout exists for SGL‑001
Assumption that no large‑animal intranasal biodistribution/tox data with validated intact‑EV analytics exist for SGL‑001
Assumption that the proposed 3‑month Stage‑1 timeline is achievable with available program resources
falsification_conditions: Produce dated MCB and WCB generation and characterization records for SGL‑001 (identity, sterility/mycoplasma testing, relevant cell‑line characterization) that demonstrate controlled source‑cell definition.
Provide full reports of validated orthogonal intact‑EV assays used for release and biodistribution (including LLOQ, specificity vs non‑vesicular signal, precision, accuracy) for SGL‑001.
Supply manufacturing records for ≥3 representative GMP‑like production runs with release test results and stability data demonstrating lot‑to‑lot comparability for critical quality attributes.
Submit validation and qualification reports showing a stability‑indicating, mechanism‑linked potency assay for SGL‑001 and evidence of correlation between assay readout and an in vivo PD endpoint.

Deliver GLP or equivalent large‑animal intranasal biodistribution/tox study reports in which intact‑EV analytics (the validated orthogonal assays above) were used to quantify EV presence in target tissues and controls demonstrate discrimination from non‑vesicular signal.
Provide a resourcing and project plan (staffing, vendor commitments, critical path milestones) that justifies completion of the Stage‑1 package within the proposed 3‑month window.
strongest_objection: The Stage‑1 gating package and the claims that SGL‑001 is not yet ready to advance rest on program‑specific data being absent — but only a high‑level consensus guideline (MISEV2023) is supplied. There is no program evidence in the provided materials to demonstrate that SGL‑001 actually lacks MCB/WCB, validated intact‑EV assays, GMP‑like batch records, stability/potency correlation data, or large‑animal intranasal biodistribution/tox studies; therefore the strongest objection is that the recommendation may be over‑assertive without confirmation of what program data already exist.
